description: In the Wazuh dashboard, navigate to the Configuration Assessment module. You can reach it from the Overview page by clicking 'Configuration Assessment' in the Endpoint Security section. The page shows CIS Benchmark compliance data for the Wazuh manager: a score percentage, number of passed checks, and number of failed checks. Click the 'Checks' tab (next to 'Dashboard') to see the individual security check results table. In the checks table, click on the first row (any failed check) to expand its details. The task is complete when a check's detail panel is open showing its title, result status (FAILED), description, and rationale text.
